title: Compile the full robust contract on every finite actual class
statement: Fixed-R Presburger-semilinear class geometry gives B=b_R(1+|x0|1) with each coordinate<=B on every FINITE actual class and N<=Nbar=(B+1)^d, without enumerating its states. The finite Markov-tree formula and relative edge perturbations give ((1-delta)/(1+delta))^(N-1)<=mu/pi<=((1+delta)/(1-delta))^(N-1), hence sup|mu/pi-1|<=8deltaN for small deltaN. Choose delta=min{1/(16Nbar),epsilon/[128Nbar(1+B)]}. This pays stationary TV and coordinate means separately using bounded B. Density/rate comparison gives perturbed Dirichlet>=nominal/4, variance<=2nominal and physical-time gap>=gamma/8, without reversibility. Bounds pi(x0)>=exp(-sum lambda)lambda^x0/x0!,mu(x0)>=pi(x0)/2 give a computable polynomial numerical mixing time with both transient errors<epsilon/4. Fixed-degree total firing intensity<=C_R(1+B)^D, so every actual firing is charged by T times this bound. All numerical resources are polynomial W and rational compiler bit resources polynomialL. This is complete on finite actual classes, including rare/singleton cases, not on arbitrary infinite classes.

assumptions: Complete positive results have EXACT finite-class, rank-one or specified-two-species scope; general interacting higher-rank infinite classes remain OPEN. Conditional transfer assumes, rather than proves generally, perturbed nonexplosion/positive recurrence/unique stationary law and sufficient uniform polynomial moments, including nominal evolution started from perturbed stationary laws. Zero per-firing gap concerns THIS uniform-degree catalytic clock, not every allowed augmentation or a full robust no-go. No novelty, physical device advantage or independent validation is claimed; all held/unread sources and transfer limits persist. Existing N1782 conservative gap/equilibrium results and the new nonconservative nominal spatial-mixing theorem are not open questions. costs: Let L be COMPLETE binary input length and W=2+|x0|1+sum(lambda_i+lambda_i^-1)+epsilon^-1. All fixed preprocessing/catalysts/constants and arithmetic are paid; compiler work/memory/output polynomial inL. This is numerical population/activity/accuracy cost, not polynomial physical cost in logarithmic population. Use accepted nominal exact-law/gap constants once. Proof cutoffs truncate a comparison distribution, not the actual network. No transient/state oracle, software sampling substitute, free clock rescaling or scientific computation by Capital.

obstruction: Construct a uniformly polynomial quantitative, independent-error-stable recurrence/moment certificate for EVERY interacting higher-rank infinite actual class, or prove a genuine obstruction over ALL permitted fixed catalytic choices.
